scope: Independent semantic-risk and authorization-boundary review of final prepared four-file A2/B2 payload; no launch or product-quality approval.

prior_a1_facts.basis: Full A1 result is pinned as a truthful failed predecessor. A2 is a distinct new one-shot root with an additional parser insertion and new finite timing scope, not rerunning consumed A1.

parser_change.effect: Use existing required-record decoder for ordinary maps too, requiring at least one real source quotation from each eligible record before nodes may end.
limits: One source quote per record does not prove actor, chronology, completion-state or meaning correctness.
It does not ensure that both original fields or all independent meanings of a record were used.
Forced anchors may still be followed by unsupported explanations.
More than24record source sets preserve the existing explicitly partial behavior.

a2_boundary.immediate_pre_stop_identity_recheck: Captured start_ticks, exact argv and serving-file hash rechecked after preflight, immediately before original provider stop.
a2_boundary.budget_limit: 265seconds is shared by both conditions. Two worst-case210second calls cannot both fit. Deadline means noncompletion and restoration, not a retry.

b2_boundary.launch_condition: Both A2 cases must be complete stop/GENERATED and adequate after independent whole-source meaning review before the separate conditional launcher is invoked. Structural success alone is insufficient.
b2_boundary.predecessor: Exact A2 driver/native/parser/core identities, two200/stop/GENERATED results, and restored PID obtained only from that A2 execution.
b2_boundary.source: Exact frozen SQL input bytes, original guard/as_of, parent request and twelve leaf messages; no post-acquisition source/guard rewrite.
b2_boundary.budget_limit: 840seconds bounds the complete service pipeline, not each stage;13responses are a maximum, not a completion guarantee.
b2_boundary.adoption: Raw output remains unadopted, pending independent final-source review. This runner performs no SQL commit or normal rollout.

credential_and_effect_boundary.existing_auth: Same-Pod loopback authentication only; original environment held in same-Pod RAM for restoring original source/argv/env/cwd. No key values are emitted in result bodies/logs.

not_claimed: New payload actual tokenizer measurements before remote preflight.
Full-history completion, actual-raw SQL save or normal API/worker rollout.
Formal product acceptance or Mash approval generated by this review.
